playstyle: A six-strong skaven pack of fragile 2-3 Health fighters with 1-dice saves, led by Skabbik, whose reach hammer strikes Grievous on criticals. Move 4 across the board, with speedy Skritter at 5, gives decent mobility, and several range 2 weapons let fighters strike from behind friends. With no warscroll of its own, it relies on a generic Chaos warscroll that rewards outnumbering foes in neutral territory or chaining melee kills. It wins by swarming and isolating targets, accepting casualties to grind opponents down.
